name: Gears of War (Games for Windows)
join_hint: Everyone signs in to a GFWL offline (local) profile, then host: Multiplayer → System Link → Host; others: Multiplayer → System Link → Join. LanBaz points GFWL at its own adapter while the room is open - start the game after joining the room.
notes: Games for Windows Live title. GFWL only sends system-link discovery on the adapter named in its ConnectionOverride setting; LanBaz sets it to the room's adapter and restores it afterwards. System link searches are broadcast on UDP 14001 (Unreal Engine 3 LAN beacon). The game rejects LAN players with a ping above about 30 ms.
